items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Charles Davis on baritone [saxophone]. We had Charlie Williams on alto [saxophone], Chris Woods.

ctx.x: Was Chris Woods a favorite musician of yours? Isn’t that right?

Yeah, Chris was one of my all-time favorites. As a matter of fact, Chris’s son, who is now about 16, is my godchild. He’s playing trumpet now. I thought he’d play the alto [saxophone], but he’s playing trumpet. They live up in – way up in New England or somewhere.
Were you writing for the band as well?
